0.0: *Cough* Hello, there. I'm #p2030012#. Surprised to see someone here? I've been living here for well on 30 years now. I'm glad you're here because I could really use a favor. It's nothing tough, so it shouldn't take up too much of your time.

yes.0: Alright! Actually, I've been here studying the basis of self-moving rocks for the past 30 years. The more visible ones at this tower are the monsters that resemble a bunch of moving stones, and I'm here to study anything and everything involving them. Conducting studies on them takes time, however, and so it is almost impossible for me to gather up the samples of them.
yes.1: I need you to go to the tower, take down the monsters, and collect the pieces that make up their bodies. I need #b30 #t4000083#s, 30 #t4000063#s, and 30 #t4000085#s#k. I'll be here waiting for you. Not like I have anywhere to be, after all.

no.0: Hmm... You must be really busy... Please come back to me when you have time

yes.0: Ohhh... This really is everything I asked for! I have a good eye for people, it seems. Anyway, I really appreciate everything you've done for me. Come to think of it, I haven't seen my Moppie for a while now. I will go back to Orbis as soon as I'm done with my research.

item.0: I'm still waiting, you know. Defeat the monsters inside Orbis Tower and bring me #b30 #t4000083# items, 30 #t4000063# items, and 30 #t4000085# items#k. I will be conducting more experiments here until you make your way back. Good luck!
